answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 35617 Country: India Title: Many representatives of mosques from small villages visit during Ramadan and they collect zakah money for constructing toilets and bathrooms inside the mosque campus Question: Many representatives of mosques from small villages visit during Ramadan and they collect zakah money for constructing toilets and bathrooms inside the mosque campus. (1) Is it permissible to give zakah money for this purpose? (2) If we have given zakah for this purpose then our zakah is accepted or not? Kindly reply in the light of Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 35617 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2030/1635/B=1432) It is not lawful to use zakah money in building toilet. This work should be done with common charity fund. If you give zakah for the construction of toilet then your zakah will not be paid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
